1.description: This indicator tracks the average IOWait percentage across all CPUs on the machine running the Splunk Enterprise instance, over the last 3 minute window. By default, this indicator will turn Yellow if the percentage exceeds 1% and Red if it exceeds 3% during this window.
1.reason: System iowait reached red threshold of 3

2.description: This indicator tracks the IOWait percentage for the single most bottle-necked CPU on the machine running the Splunk Enterprise instance, over the last 3 minute window. By default, this indicator will turn Yellow if the percentage exceeds 5% and Red if it exceeds 10% during this window.
2.reason: Maximum per-cpu iowait reached red threshold of 10

3.description: This indicator tracks the sum of IOWait percentage for the three most bottle-necked CPUs on the machine running the Splunk Enterprise instance, over the last 3 minute window. By default, this indicator will turn Yellow if the sum exceeds 7 and Red if it exceeds 15 during this window.
3.reason: Sum of 3 highest per-cpu iowaits reached red threshold of 15
